verdict.rationale: Power and cooling specs are a fair question for any GPU, so the axis applies. However, the pack publishes no TDP/TGP figure, no power-connector requirements and no cooling guidance for the H200 SXM. It only says the H200 runs within 'the same power profile as the H100' without a number, and the air-cooled remark refers to the separate H200 NVL variant, not this card.
